user.title: Radiation Watch
user.description: Dose rate stations around your home (German BfS network and European EURDEP), wind based early warning and a map card. Map tiles are downloaded once from OpenStreetMap and then served locally.

data_description.latitude: Centre of the map, defaults to your Home Assistant location.
data_description.radius_far: Radius of the far view and of the station search. Stations further away are ignored.
data_description.wind_entity: Provides wind direction and speed (attributes wind_bearing and wind_speed).
data_description.wind_fallback: Used when the first one has no wind data.

error.far_not_larger: The far radius must be larger than the near radius.

abort.already_configured: Radiation Watch is already set up.
abort.single_instance_allowed: Radiation Watch is already set up.

init.title: Radiation Watch options
init.description: Changing location or radii rebuilds the map images.

data.notify_notable: Also notify when a station is notable

data_description.latitude: Centre of the map, defaults to your Home Assistant location.
data_description.radius_far: Radius of the far view and of the station search. Stations further away are ignored.
data_description.wind_entity: Provides wind direction and speed (attributes wind_bearing and wind_speed).
data_description.wind_fallback: Used when the first one has no wind data.
data_description.abs_threshold: A station at or above this value is always notable.
data_description.median_factor: A station is notable when it is above median x factor and above median + minimum distance.
data_description.median_offset: A station is notable when it is above median x factor and above median + minimum distance.
data_description.sector: A notable station within this angle either side of the wind direction raises a warning.
data_description.min_wind: Below this the wind direction is too unsteady to be used.
data_description.notify_services: Notify services, for example notify.mobile_app_phone. Empty: no notifications. The entities and the alert event work either way.
data_description.notify_notable: Otherwise only for a warning (notable station upwind).
data_description.notify_all_clear: When the level goes back to calm.

error.far_not_larger: The far radius must be larger than the near radius.
